about_the_game:
Spot the Difference × ADV (Adventure Game)


You are Baku.

Today, once again,
an animal has come to you
complaining of insomnia.

Eat their nightmares
and save these troubled animals.

However, there is a secret to this story.

Overview

'BAKU' is a
single-player mistake-finding game.
Compare the illustrations on the left and right to find the mistakes.
The ending will branch depending on the results of the mistake-finding.

Playing time
1–2 hours

*Our circle creates games with playing times that are easy to play in live videos and streams.

Minimum:

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: intel UHD graphics 620
